description: This PHP source file contains functions for delivering VAST video ads, generating VAST XML, handling video player URLs, preparing ad parameters, and rendering ad output for a video advertising system, specifically related to VAST inline banners and overlays.

methods.name: deliverVastAd
methods.description: Generates ad output for a VAST inline or overlay ad based on parameters, including tracking, companion banners, and overlay rendering.

methods.name: getVastXMLHeader
methods.description: Returns the XML header for a VAST XML document with specified charset.

methods.name: getVastXMLFooter
methods.description: Returns the closing tag for a VAST XML document.

methods.name: getVideoPlayerUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the video player SWF or JS file based on a parameter ID.

methods.name: extractVastParameters
methods.description: Unserializes and merges VAST parameters into the banner array.

methods.name: prepareVideoParams
methods.description: Prepares video-specific parameters for VAST ad output, including duration, bitrate, size, and type.

methods.name: prepareOverlayParams
methods.description: Prepares overlay-specific parameters for VAST overlay ads, including size, destination URL, and format.

methods.name: prepareCompanionBanner
methods.description: Prepares companion banner markup and size for VAST ads if a companion banner ID is specified.

methods.name: prepareTrackingParams
methods.description: Sets up impression and tracking URLs for VAST ad tracking events.

methods.name: _adRenderBuildVideoClickThroughUrl
methods.description: Builds the click-through URL for a VAST video ad, including signing and redirect URL.

methods.name: getVastVideoAdOutput
methods.description: Generates the XML markup for a VAST video ad including media files and tracking events.

methods.name: renderVastOutput
methods.description: Creates the VAST XML ad markup for inline or overlay ads, including companion ads and overlays.

methods.name: renderPlayerInPage
methods.description: Returns HTML/JavaScript code for previewing the video ad in a webpage.

methods.name: renderCompanionInAdminTool
methods.description: Returns HTML for previewing the companion banner in admin tools.

methods.name: renderOverlayInAdminTool
methods.description: Returns HTML for previewing the overlay in admin tools, based on overlay format.

methods.name: secondsToVASTDuration
methods.description: Converts seconds into HH:MM:SS format for VAST duration.
